name: Republic of Venice
label: VENICE
note: Lagoon and maritime possessions; the great Venetian mainland expansion is later.

name: Kingdom of France
gameplayNote: Gameplay: the small unassigned pocket near Amiens/Champagne is restored to France.

name: Sultanate of Rum
label: RÛM
note: Seljuk sultanate under Ilkhanid suzerainty; local control was fragmented.

name: Byzantine Empire
label: BYZANTIUM
note: Bursa, Nicaea and Nicomedia remain Byzantine; Ottoman conquests of these cities came after 1300.

name: Duchy of Upper Bavaria
label: UPPER BAVARIA
gameplayNote: Gameplay: Augsburg and its bishopric are incorporated into Upper Bavaria.

name: Prince-Bishopric of Strasbourg
label: STRASBOURG
gameplayNote: Gameplay: eastern Lorraine is folded into Strasbourg.

name: County Palatine of the Rhine
label: PALATINATE
gameplayNote: Gameplay: Speyer, Worms and the Speyer bishopric are incorporated into the Palatinate.

name: Kingdom of Bohemia
label: BOHEMIA
gameplayNote: Gameplay: the tiny user-marked wedge on the south-west Bohemian border is incorporated into Bohemia.

name: County of Luxembourg
label: LUXEMBOURG
gameplayNote: Gameplay: the full user-circled pocket west/south-west of Luxembourg is assigned to Luxembourg.

name: Archbishopric of Mainz
label: MAINZ
note: Mainz also held scattered territories; the core is generalized here.
gameplayNote: Gameplay: Frankfurt is incorporated into Mainz for the current Cardwars map repartition.

name: Archbishopric of Cologne
label: COLOGNE
gameplayNote: Gameplay: Cologne is one continuous territory; the north-east tip is part of the main polygon so no internal border is drawn.

name: Free Imperial City of Bremen
label: BREMEN
gameplayNote: Gameplay footprint generalized around Bremen; the square city enclave is removed.

name: Duchy of Saxe-Lauenburg
label: LAUENBURG
gameplayNote: Gameplay: detached fragments are assigned to adjacent states; Saxe-Lauenburg has one connected mainland territory.

name: Kingdom of Naples
label: NAPLES
note: Angevin mainland kingdom, separate from the island ruled by Frederick III.

name: Caralis
label: CARALIS
gameplayNote: Gameplay: residual Sardinia coastline fragments are absorbed into the three intended Sardinian states, removing overlap-colour artifacts.

name: Judicate of Arborea
label: ARBOREA
gameplayNote: Gameplay: residual Sardinia coastline fragments are absorbed into the three intended Sardinian states, removing overlap-colour artifacts.

name: Gallura
label: GALLURA
gameplayNote: Gameplay: residual Sardinia coastline fragments are absorbed into the three intended Sardinian states, removing overlap-colour artifacts.

name: Marquisate of Saluzzo
label: SALUZZO
gameplayNote: Gameplay: the tiny residual Provence fragment on the border is assigned to Saluzzo.

name: Lordship of Verona
label: VERONA
note: Della Scala lordship; Vicenza and Padua are not part of the later Scaliger expansion.

name: Lordship of Milan
label: MILAN
gameplayNote: Gameplay: Waldstatte and the Commune of Como are incorporated into the Lordship of Milan.

name: Ottoman Beylik
label: OTTOMANS
note: Small inland frontier beylik around Sogut, Bilecik and Inegol; not the 1337 Ottoman territory.

name: Candar Beylik
label: CANDAR
note: Core around Eflani; Kastamonu was acquired only in 1309.

name: Andorra
label: ANDORRA
gameplayNote: Gameplay border rounded for readability while preserving the small Pyrenean polity.

name: Duchy of Burgundy
label: BURGUNDY
gameplayNote: Gameplay: Franche-Comte and the detached southern Lorraine fragment are incorporated into Burgundy.

name: County of Champagne
label: CHAMPAGNE
gameplayNote: Gameplay border follows the user-marked split: the western sliver returns to France, while the circled strip below Hainaut is assigned to Champagne.

name: Archbishopric of Lyon
label: LYON
gameplayNote: Gameplay: the circled French wedge immediately north of Lyon is incorporated into Lyon.

name: Archbishopric of Vienne
label: VIENNE
gameplayNote: Gameplay: Vienne is enlarged westward with a smoother shared border with Lyon.

name: Kingdom of Majorca
label: MONTPELLIER
gameplayNote: Gameplay: Montpellier retains its Majorcan allegiance with a non-rectangular footprint.
